findings.title: OAC 5160-1-31 Prior authorization (Ohio Medicaid)
findings.quote: Reimbursement for certain items or services covered under the medicaid program is dependent on obtaining prior authorization from the Ohio department of medicaid (ODM).
findings.note: Governing FFS PA rule; companion OAC 5160-4-22 Surgical services (eff. 1/1/2022, fetched) covers surgery payment but contains no clinical criteria. ODM PA-requirements page (FFS code lists) timed out on repeated fetches. Most members in Next Generation MCOs applying own InterQual/MCG criteria.

findings.title: OAC 317:30-3-31 Prior authorization for health care-related goods and services (OHCA policy site)
findings.quote: PA is a process to determine if a prescribed good or service is medically necessary
findings.note: OHCA Medical Authorization Unit reviews surgical PA using InterQual; public InterQual transparency link posted on OHCA MAU page (prod.ds.interqual.com/service/connect/transparency?tid=f2999e83-a29f-47e9-a737-0e9e620fc1f5). No public procedure-specific ortho criteria; SoonerSelect MCOs administer PA for most members.

findings.title: HERC Prioritized List of Health Services, January 1, 2026
findings.note: Fetched and confirmed current (funded lines 1-470 through 12/31/2026 per OHA). OHP coverage of joint replacement/spine surgery is governed by Prioritized List line placement plus HERC guideline notes in this document; the ~900-page PDF truncated in tooling before the musculoskeletal lines, so specific line/guideline-note numbers for TKA/THA are deliberately NOT asserted (use HERC Searchable List at oregon.gov/oha/HPA/DSI-HERC/Pages/Searchable-List.aspx to pull the line for a code). PA goes to OHA (FFS) or the member's CCO.

findings.title: 55 Pa. Code sec. 1101.67 Prior authorization
findings.quote: If a recipient is not notified of a decision on a request for a covered service or item within 21 days of the date the written request is received by the Department, the authorization is automatically approved.
findings.note: Official text on pacodeandbulletin.gov is robots-blocked to fetchers; Cornell mirror fetched. PA-required procedures are flagged on the MA Program Fee Schedule; PROMISe provider handbooks give process. Most members in HealthChoices MCOs, which apply their own UM criteria under DHS oversight. No state ortho-specific criteria published.

findings.title: EOHHS Physician Manual - Prior Approval (PA) Criteria For Surgical Procedures
findings.quote: Documented clinical evidence of surgery for benign disease when a subcutaneous mastectomy is performed with immediate or delayed prosthesis
findings.note: The state's surgical PA-criteria page (fetched) covers only 9 procedures (bariatric, mammoplasty, rhinoplasty, gender dysphoria, etc.) - NO orthopedic procedures have published FFS criteria. Ortho PA is handled under general coverage guidelines and by MCOs (Neighborhood, UHC, Tufts) using their own criteria.

findings.title: SCDHHS Physicians Services Provider Manual
findings.effective_date: current edition tracked to 07/01/26 per Change Control Record
findings.note: Manual PDF host (provider.scdhhs.gov) has a broken TLS chain that blocks automated fetch; existence and currency verified via the official landing page (scdhhs.gov/providers/manuals/physicians-services-provider-manual, fetched) and the Physicians Manual Change Control Record 07-01-26 (fetched; shows QIO surgical-PA code changes eff. 1/1/26). MCOs use InterQual/MCG for most members.

findings.title: South Dakota Medicaid Billing and Policy Manual - Physician Services
findings.quote: Services must be prior authorized by South Dakota Medicaid to bill an unlisted E/M service, CPT code 99499.
findings.note: Largely FFS. Companion General Coverage Principles manual (fetched, updated June 2026) sets the medical-necessity definition and states 'South Dakota Medicaid requires prior authorization for certain services,' pointing to the DSS website PA list. No published ortho-specific criteria; routine ortho surgery generally not PA-gated in FFS.

findings.title: Tenn. Comp. R. & Regs. 1200-13-16-.05 Medical Necessity Criteria (TennCare)
findings.quote: The reasonably anticipated medical benefits of the item or service must outweigh the reasonably anticipated medical risks based on the enrollee's condition.
findings.note: TennCare is ~100% managed care with no central FFS ortho policy; this uniform medical-necessity rule (safe/effective/least costly alternative standard) binds all MCO UM decisions, which otherwise use InterQual/MCG. Official SOS rules PDF (publications.tnsosfiles.com) returns 403 to fetchers; Cornell mirror fetched.

findings.title: TMPPM Vol.2 Medical and Nursing Specialists, Physicians, and Physician Assistants Handbook (August 2026)
findings.note: Current physician/surgery chapter PDF of the TMPPM, incl. Surgery Billing Guidelines (Sec. 9.2.74, p.228); fetched and confirmed current, but the ~large PDF truncated before an ortho-PA criterion could be quoted verbatim. FFS PA handled by TMHP (TMPPM Vol.1 Sec.5); STAR MCOs use InterQual/MCG.

findings.title: Utah Medicaid Provider Manual - Physician Services (online edition)
findings.quote: For Medicaid medical or surgical services requiring prior authorization, the physician must obtain approval from Medicaid before service is rendered to the patient.
findings.note: Code-specific PA criteria are published per-CPT in the Coverage and Reimbursement Code Lookup Tool (health.utah.gov/stplan/lookup/CoverageLookup.php - http-only form app, fetched; criteria returned per code/date, not URL-addressable) and via Utah's public InterQual transparency portal (elt.medicaid.utah.gov/transparencytool) linked from medicaid.utah.gov/utah-medicaid-criteria/.

findings.title: DVHA Procedure Criteria (clinical criteria for prior-authorized procedures)
findings.note: State publishes its own procedure criteria PDFs here, incl. spine-adjacent 'Total Artificial Cervical Disc Replacement' (upd. 9/12/25) and 'SI Joint Fusion' (upd. 7/8/26); no criteria published for TKA/THA/rotator cuff/ACL etc. (InterQual-style review otherwise). Criteria PDFs under /sites/dvha/ are robots-blocked to fetchers, so no verbatim criterion quotable; the index page itself was fetched. Fee schedules carry PA flags per code.

findings.title: DMAS Practitioner Manual - Appendix D Service Authorization
findings.quote: The purpose of service authorization is to validate that the service requested is medically necessary and meets DMAS criteria for reimbursement.
findings.note: Deepest practitioner-manual SA document (fetched); it defers surgical/inpatient SA detail to the Hospital Manual SA appendix. Acentra Health is the DMAS SA contractor; Cardinal Care MCOs (most members) use own InterQual/MCG criteria. Full chapter list at vamedicaid.dmas.virginia.gov/pdf_chapter/practitioner.

findings.title: Apple Health Physician-Related Services/Health Care Professional Services Billing Guide
findings.quote: What criteria will Comagine Health use to establish medical necessity?
findings.note: Quote is a verbatim section heading from the guide (fetched; full criteria text beyond the truncation window). Guide sends listed surgical procedures to Comagine Health medical-necessity review and contains an Expedited PA (EPA) criteria section (~p.294, incl. EPA #870001420). WA HTCC health-technology decisions (e.g., lumbar fusion, knee arthroscopy for OA) also bind Apple Health. MCOs use InterQual/MCG.

findings.title: BMS Provider Manual Chapter 519.16 Surgical Services
findings.quote: West Virginia Medicaid requires Prior Authorization for ALL hospital admissions and specific surgeries performed in offices, outpatient hospital settings, and ambulatory surgical centers.
findings.note: Dedicated surgical-services policy chapter (fetched via bms.wv.gov chapter-519 page). Clinical criteria delegated to 'nationally accredited, evidence-based' tools such as InterQual as approved by BMS; Mountain Health Trust MCOs apply own criteria.

findings.title: ForwardHealth Online Handbook - Physician Services: Covered Services and Requirements (current)
findings.quote: Wisconsin Medicaid reimburses only for services that are medically necessary as defined under Wis. Admin. Code sec. DHS 101.03(96m).
findings.note: This is the CURRENT Online Handbook section (Print.aspx render bypasses the portal's CPT click-through gate), superseding the 2005 archival phy_medicine_surgery.pdf. Topic #84 Medical Necessity quoted. PA-per-code via ForwardHealth interactive PA list; BadgerCare Plus HMOs apply own criteria.

findings.title: Wyoming Medicaid CMS-1500 Provider Manual v19.0
findings.note: Fetched and confirmed current. Quick Reference (Sec. 2.1) assigns PA for 'Surgeries (limited)' and other services to Telligen (UM/QIO), which takes requests via Qualitrac (wymedicaid.telligen.com); no state-published ortho criteria (Telligen applies state/InterQual criteria). FFS statewide, no full-risk MCOs.

findings.title: DC MMIS Provider Billing Manual - Physicians V7.07
findings.note: Deepest identified FFS document; dc-medicaid.com blocks automated fetch (robots.txt unreachable/DNS errors), so title/version confirmed only via search index - not content-verified. DCMR Title 29 Ch.9 rule list (dcregs.dc.gov, fetched) shows no surgical-PA rule. Most beneficiaries are in MCOs (AmeriHealth Caritas DC, MedStar Family Choice, CareFirst CHPD) applying their own UM criteria.
